title: AC1024 mechanical dimension constraint node dependency closure

implementation.summary: For every source dimension dependency, require exactly one matching constraint node in the owning constraint group. Admit only Distance and RadiusDiameter node kinds, and require both dimension and value references to use hard-pointer roles. Resolve the value edge to a typed, wire-complete ACDBASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY listed exactly once among the owning group action handles, then resolve its dependency target to a typed ACDBASSOCVARIABLE.

physicalGate.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary DXF
physicalGate.observed: Both encodings reported 17 linked dependency/body pairs, all 399 constraint nodes, group and dimension roles, atomic refusal, same-adapter retry, and typed readback. The strengthened one-to-one dimension-node and value-dependency edges passed for all 17 dimension dependencies.

coverage: Unique source constraint-node reference for each of 17 dimension dependencies
Admitted Distance or RadiusDiameter node kind
Hard-pointer dimension and value dependency roles
Unique typed and wire-complete value dependency in the owning group's action list
Typed associative-variable target for each value dependency
ASCII and Binary output, fresh DXF readback, mutation refusal, sentinel preservation, and corrected retry

fixturePolicy: No DWG or DXF fixture was added or committed; the source is an existing local LibreCAD research sample.
limitations: This proves a bounded source-profile graph and selected output path only; it does not qualify whole-drawing conversion.
